Even at 1kbps, you're still transmitting 82 megabytes per day.(1000360024)/(1024*1024).

As to how they do it: big antenna farms on earth and orthogonal/biorthogonal coding. Big array of antennas allows you to filter out everything that's not coming directly from Pluto. Orthogonal-type coding (in direct contrast to WiFi/cell coding) are able to through very low signal to noise ratios by taking advantage of wide bandwidth.
